name: Kururugi Seina
source:
Seina lost her father at a tender age and grew up in a single-parent household. With a younger brother to care for and a mother who was always busy with work, Seina assumed all the domestic chores during her academic days. Though she's level-headed and reliable, she has a slightly ingenuous side to her as well.

Seina has a strong maternal instinct and is always nurturing others. Likewise, she can't resist the urge to offer her support when she witnesses a man's careless or piteous side. Her empathetic nature runs deep, and her dedication knows no bounds once she devotes herself to someone.

Until she started college and found a job, Seina was on the verge of developing a distrust for men. But meeting Subaru helped put her heart at ease. Though Subaru excels at his career, his daily life is in disarray, and Seina feels compelled to support him, bringing them closer together.

Eventually, Subaru mustered up the courage to confess his feelings, and they started dating. Six months later, he proposed, and they tied the knot. Seina continued to work but transferred to a different department to avoid mixing her personal and professional life.

Likes: Coffee, Cleaning, Budget-friendly cosmetics
Dislikes: Celery, Horror
